files.description: Project plan and conclusions: why the runtime exists, what was measured, what comes next

Measured effect and cost of the laya-mlx speed settings (dense_upto, headprune, unpad, in round 2 the fuserope Metal kernel, in round 3 band, nax, the loading settings and MLX_MAX_MB_PER_BUFFER) and the reviews that made them default
fp16 slowdown fix, MLX buffer cache cap and length buckets in the MLX backend
sys1d server design choices, protocol parity with upstream laya serve, measured overhead
Benchmark ground rules, request and result formats, correctness gate
